text: Talar Oaktalon is a night elf druid and ship captain of Elune's Radiance, sent by Darnassus to assist Gilneas with the worgen. He was tall and adorned with ornate leather armor and robes made of silken blue-green cloth, and wielded a staff. He later led the other ships in evacuating Gilneans to Teldrassil after the Forsaken led by Sylvanas Windrunner conquered their homeland. When he first offered Genn Greymane his help, it was rejected because of the king's stubbornness. During the voyage, Talar saved Mia Greymane and Tess Greymane, Genn's wife and daughter, from drowning after their vessel was nearly destroyed, healing their wounds. He then personally rescued Genn himself from a similar fa
Talanas Windrunner was the first ranger-general of Silvermoon, and a prominent member of the Windrunner family during the Troll Wars. He was the first wielder of the bow Thas'dorah.
Talric Forthright is a human found inside the Command Center of the Old Town in Stormwind City. He was previously a vendor, offering Cataclysm profession supplies in exchange for Justice Points.

Talonixa was a golden proto-dragon who led the intelligent proto-dragons against Galakrond and the undead. She was larger than most proto-dragons, with only Neltharion and a few others being bigger. Talonixa was commanding and cunning, and Malygos did not trust her. Her mate, Zorix, was a victim of Galakrond, and Talonixa became the alpha of the proto-dragons and quickly encouraged the other proto-dragons to destroy Galakrond and the not-living. She was noticed to have given Coros, Malygos's rival, favor as evidenced by her allowing him to hunt with her and Coros appeared to have some sway over her, as evidenced by him convincing her to allow Ysera to speak her belief of peace with Galakrond
Tallevia Mistsong is a blood elf flight master located at the Life Vault Ruins in the Waking Shores.
Tanaya Perch is a human located in the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind City. She is seen speaking with Antoinette Jardin.

Tayutka is a goddess worshipped by the tuskarr. Her spirit is said to have guided the tuskarr's ancestors to the sacred town of Kaskala. There is an altar to her on the central island in Njord's Breath Bay just outside the town. Alongside the other tuskarr deities, Tayutka supposedly aided Kaskala when it was attacked by the kvaldir, specifically by ensuring that the survivors had food and shelter. The Iskaal Refugees taking shelter in Kamagua can ask Tayutka to repay the people of Kamagua for their kindness.
Tawny Seabraid is a dwarf located at T&W Trading Post in the Canals in Stormwind City. She is a co-owner of the trading post, along with Wilder Seabraid.
Teegan Holloway is the Forsaken commander of the Forsaken Looters searching the Tower of Althalaxx after the Horde destroyed it.

Telda Stonefist is a dwarf and the captain of the Lion of the Waves during the navy battle near Durotar against Garrosh and his army after the fall of Theramore. However, the ship was amongst many ships that were destroyed during the battle. Even Varian Wrynn was unsure what happened to her, but it is likely that she died.
Teller Almeida is a human banker located at the Dalaran Merchant's Bank in Dalaran. When Dalaran blinked above Karazhan, Almeida was caught in an arcane ball and was seen flying behind the counter.

Temporal Shield is a Arcane-exclusive mage PvP talent, available at Level 30, a weaker version of Alter Time. This ability does not actively shield you from damage, but once the shield expires after 4 seconds, the mage is instantly healed for all the damage received. It is automatically cancelled upon death, and can also be dispelled by other players.

Terrance Denman is a human jewelcrafting supplies vendor located in his shop Denman Family Jewelers in Stormwind City. He can be found standing outside the shop, which is located on the edge of the Trade District, bordering the Canals. He and Theresa Denman own and run the shop, which deals with the profession of jewelcrafting. Specifically, he sells a wide variety of jewelcrafting designs.

Thaelin Darkanvil is a Dark Iron dwarf and genius engineer of the Dark Iron clan that accompanied the Alliance on the alternate Draenor. He set up a bunker and secret workshop in Gorgrond, but was kidnapped by the Iron Horde who forced him to work for them, until he was saved. Thaelin has numerous creations, among which a personal ram-headed siege engine named The Tank, and a Dark Iron golem named The Suit which he could equip, but it was destroyed.

Teshara is a night elf druid who participated in the War of the Thorns. She is very young, appearing to be barely into her training. She is described as slight with a shock of short green hair. After the Horde began to push through Ashenvale toward Darnassus, Malfurion Stormrage sent Teshara to recall the night elven fleet, which was at the time en route to Feralas. Teshara reached Shandris Feathermoon and Cordressa Briarbow's ship in storm crow form and delivered the dire news, then — on Shandris' orders — prepared to inform the ships farther behind in the fleet, despite heir exhaustion. Shandris told Teshara that she might have saved her people by delivering the message, and the young drui
Thaldrus was a worgen pack leader mentioned by Gaedrin Moonfang in his Faded Journal. He succeeded Renthel as the pack leader in a duel.

Thaeldus Thorngale is a night elf member of the Druids of the Flame found in a cave in Lushdream Crags in the Emerald Dream, meditating. Solarys wanted her family to leave the cult, and after she approached Amirdrassil, she expected her siblings to follow suit as well. Thaeldus, on the other hand, wanted to stay in the Flame and killed his sister Lyandris as she was trying to leave with the Flame's strategic documents. He was found by an adventurer, sent by Solarys, and revealed to them what he has done and attacked them. During the fight, he was overwhelmed by fire magic, which consumed him, and died.

Thathung was a grunt found patrolling around the auction house, where he once worked as an auctioneer, in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. After the betrayal of Varimathras and Putress, Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken refugees had to escape to Orgrimmar. During that time, Orgrimmar was under martial law and the auctioneer was complaining about the situation along with other citizens. Having been promoted to Overseer, he is found holding on to Theramore Citizens in chains during the Siege of Orgrimmar where he can be killed.

Tharek Blackstone is a dwarf located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Tharek works as a toolsmith, and his biggest customer is Beldin Steelgrill, who owns Steelgrill's Depot, making poor Blackstone an overworked toolsmith. He is known to ask those in need of coin to bring Beldin new supplies, and directs them to the depot. Tharek might have some kind of authority since Jona Ironstock asks the adventurer to go to him for help instead of asking the Mountaineers, suggesting he may have the means to help the people of Anvilmar. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the town by throwing dynamites at the demons.
Thane Yoregar is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley. He is found speaking to Earthmender Sophurus.

Tharbek was a fierce young orc warrior and a subchieftain under Orgrim Doomhammer during the Second War. After Orgrim learned about the betrayal of Gul'dan from Torgus, Tharbek reported the loss of the passages in the Alterac Mountains. The Horde then retreated back to Blackrock Spire, Tharbek accompanying them and battling there against the Alliance. As he was not seen again, it is presumed that he perished during the battle.

Tharifas was a green dragon who, based on the presence of custom game data there, originally was to appear in 3rd chapter of the Night Elf campaign of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. He/she was related to a quest involving a dragon roost and some dragon whelps. However, this quest was removed from the game before it was released. As a result, the Tharifas unit is only used within the map data for the Night Elf interlude "The Last Guardian", with two copies flying over the Orc/Human battle but never quite within the visible camera frame.
Thaumaturge Moonspire is a night elf mage of the 7th Legion encountered in the Domination Point scenario. __NOTOC__

Thalrisa was a night elf who lived on Silvermyst Isle. When the wildkin on the island became aggressive due to the draenei's crystal fragments, she was killed by their rampage. Her remains were recovered and given to her husband, Cowlen with whom she had a daughter named Magwin.

Therum Deepforge is a dwarf expert blacksmithing trainer located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He is the royal armorer of the House of Wrynn. During the Cataclysm, King Varian commissioned Therum to forge a weapon for young adventurers of the Alliance, and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, Farseer Umbrua, Ander Germaine, and Lord Tony Romano specifically spoke with Therum about their students and the materials. After receiving the materials, Dane Lindgren assisted him in forging the weapons. Following the armistice of the Fourth War, he expressed dissatisfaction with King Anduin Wrynn decisions to help Varok Saurfang and be present at its funeral. His alternate self appears in the Vis
Thelman Slatefist is a dwarf located in the War Room of Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. He serves as a battlemaster for Alterac Valley.

Theresa Wolf is a human found in the Scribe's Sacellum of Dalaran. She sometimes uses magic to lift books up and put them on the many shelves that fill the shop where she works. She recommends giving the Tome of Sin'dorei Secrets a read.
Thorfin Stoneshield is a level 40 hunter trainer located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.

Thomas is a human boy located in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. He serves as an altar boy in the cathedral and can be found walking up and down the building's length. Following the war against the Lich King, the cathedral conducted a ceremony for the fallen. As Anduin Wrynn arrived, the Stormwind Prince exchanged smiles and nods with Thomas.
Thorgrum Borrelson is a dwarf gryphon flight master located on the hill above Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

Thok was an orc chieftain that went through the Dark Portal to Azeroth around the time of the First War. He fell down but wasn't hurt. On the other side of the portal, he found many good things to eat. He and his companions found a human village, killed the inhabitants and ate their food. However, when Thok attempted to document the event, he was forced to stop as writing caused his head to hurt. When scribing the history of the First War, Garona Halforcen presented Thok's writings as an example of how the orcish chieftains, while fine leaders in war, lacked the ability to convey those actions with written words when documenting the past.

Thomas Westmill is a human banker located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found in the Stormwind Counting House, the third banker on the left when you enter. He is a member of the Westmill family, who can be found behind the windows on the east side of the bank, opposite the Burnsides. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind.

Thol'embaar is a fire elemental lord. His true name, Vol'talo Thol'embaar, has considerable power, and the character learns it during the quest The Name Never Spoken to help defeat him. During Black Heart of Flame, the character summons Thol'embaar and defeats him, ending the fire elemental threat to the Grove of Aessina.
Thraka is an orc flight master located at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.
Thornstalker Nydora is a human located in Boralus. She and her team participate in Island Expeditions.
Thornspeaker Tavery is a human located in Boralus. He and his team participate in Island Expeditions.
Thornguard Burton is a human located in Boralus. He and his team participate in Island Expeditions.
Thulman Flintcrag is a dwarf gun vendor located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind, having barricaded the entrance to his shop, with guns at the ready.
Thrend is an orc fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.
Thurman Mullby is a human general goods vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found inside his shop Everyday Merchandise, on the corner of the central square.

Thysta is an orc flight master located at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. During the war against the Zandalari, Thysta aided the Darkspear emissaries to get to the other locations and defended the base camp from invading Gurubashi trolls led by Bloodlord Mandokir.
Thurda is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon flight master located in the small camp of Gunstan's Dig in Tanaris.
Tiger Claws is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Crosswinds, Healing Winds, and Transfer the Power (artifact trait) traits.
Tidesage Enuser is a human located in Proudmoore Keep in Boralus. He is channeling magic into Mekkatorque's Escape Pod.
Timeless Runeback is a dragon turtle located in Island Expeditions.
Tiper Windman is a human flight master located at the Alliance-held tower The Lion's Redoubt on the Serpent's Spine, in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Tipsi Wobblerune is a gnome mage who appears outside the Legerdemain Lounge and A Hero's Welcome in the Broken Isles version of Dalaran during the Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl. To start the Tavern Crawl, Alliance players have to talk to her in Dalaran. Her image subsequently appears in each tavern that the player visits in order to teleport them to the next tavern. Her Horde counterpart is Anebria Sunwine.
Titanic Power is a Fury warrior artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.
Tomas Riverwell is a human gryphon flight master located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Tokrog is an orc flight master located at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

Tolla Kol'gar was an orc shaman who belonged to the same clan as Gelnar. She was among the participants in a battle between Gelnar's clan and the armies of the Gorian Empire, where Gelnar used his weapon, the Doomhammer, to empower his fellow orcs with the blessing of the elements. Tolla's writings form the second part of the story of the Doomhammer recounted in Words of Wind and Earth.
Todd Borden is a human located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
Todd Abel is a human monk trainer found in Gilneas City during the worgen starting experience.
Toren Landow is a human legacy :Justice Points vendor in the Champion's Hall in the human capital of Stormwind City.
Tore is an orc fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.

Toreth Bluestar is a night elf "Lorekeeper", meaning it is his duty to record the names and noteworthy deeds of his fellow kaldorei. He is small but handsome, with teal skin and a tangle of green hair. He was orphaned at a very young age. The Sentinel Keda Bloomblade fell in love with Toreth but lacked the confidence to tell him, instead often turning clumsy and awkward in his presence. After a ceremony in which Keda was honored for having defended a shrine from a bog beast, Toreth approached her to ask her questions about the battle. This gave her the idea to impress him and work up the courage to confess her feelings by performing feats of heroism. She began throwing herself against increa

Torq Ironblast is a dwarf gun vendor located in Foothold Citadel on Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle. During the Third War, Torq Ironblast was part of the Gilneas Brigade in the Stonetalon Mountains. His base was attacked by Grommash Hellscream and his Warsong clan. He was then guarding the entrance to the Stonetalon Peak.
Tormented Souls is a vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Infernal Force, Soul Carver (artifact trait), and Shatter the Souls traits.

Trad Stormtread is a dwarf that accompanied Commander Rell Nightwind and his team to an uncharted island to rescue the White Pawn but seemingly perished when they approached the Jade Forest and were ambushed by the Horde.

Trand was an officer of Alterac that learned about Aiden Perenolde's decision of abandoning the Alliance of Lordaeron and letting the Horde march to Lordaeron through Alterac's mountains. It is unknown what happened to him after the Second War.
Trellar Snowglove is a night elf participating in the Darkmoon Faire dancing contest.

Trogra is an orc corpse located at a small hut in southern Zorammarsh in Tanaan Jungle. Her journal reveals that following a mutiny and the murder of Captain Ironbeard at the hands of Torglork and the rest of the crew, she secretly bribed a warlock to resurrect Ironbeard using a magical artifact. However, the ritual failed and Ironbeard was only "mostly" resurrected. She was seemingly discovered and murdered, shot down by a hail of arrows by the remaining crew, now serving under an impostor captain.
Trueshot Aura is a hunter talent in the Marksmanship tree. It is an aura that increases the attack power of all party members within a 45 yard radius of the Hunter.

Tryanikus is a green dragon located in the Emerald Dreamway, and in the Emerald Dream where he assisted in empowering the Reforged Emerald Essence. He also appears on Mount Hyjal. Tryanikus in his night elf visage appears at the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains, lecturing a group of Sisters of the Garden.

Tusklord Hrak'kar is the racial leader of the tuskarr. Little is known about him. He resides within the great tuskarr capital of Kaskala within the Borean Tundra on the frozen continent of Northrend. He decides the schedule for Kaskala's citizens. Hrak'kar spreads the tasks evenly so no one village bears the brunt of any task or has too few men to bring in food.

Turgore is an orc and a member of Budd's gang. He first appeared outside Zul'Aman in the Ghostlands, later traveling to Granite Springs in the Grizzly Hills. After the Shattering, he traveled with Budd and the others aboard a mercenary ship that was attacked and wound up underwater in Vashj'ir. After escaping back to land, he joined an expedition to Uldum.

Turp is a dwarf found at a small, hidden camp at the waterfalls northeast of Stormwind City along with Roo and their two corgis, Tof and Nom. He and Roo used to be adventurers, fighting from Stormwind to Pandaria and even Outland, but they have recently decided to settle down in a quiet place far from battle.
Twain is a human walking with Miss Danna all around Stormwind City.

Twilight Lord Kelris is an orc boss found in the Moonshrine Sanctum of Blackfathom Deeps. Kelris was the leader of the Twilight's Hammer in the Deeps who eluded the Argent Dawn in Darnassus for some time. They even considered him dead or missing for some time, but they knew that whenever evil made its presence known in Kalimdor, Kelris had played a role. According to Bashana Runetotem, Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. He supervised the growth of the hydra Aku'mai. When Twilight Lord Bathiel assumed control of the Deeps and the Twilight's Hammer after the Cataclysm, his first act was to throw his
Tyr'kyn was a Moon Guard sorcerer who was searching for the orc Broxigar. He was killed in an ambush by fel beasts.

Twin Disciplines is a Tier 1 Discipline priest talent. It increases the power of all spells from the and schools cast by the priest. As every priest spell belongs to one of these schools, it effectively increases all spell damage and healing done by the priest.
Ulfir Ironbeard is a level 50 hunter trainer located in the Dwarven District within Stormwind City.
Ukra'nor was an orc staff vendor located just west of the Valley of Spirits in the shop called Skyfury Staves in orcish city of Orgrimmar.

Ulmok was a Shattered Hand orc blacksmith. After the ogre Throgg joined the Hand, Ulmok showed him the variety of weapons he could now use. At some point, during the battles against the Alliance, Ulmok was killed by an elf. Throgg killed the elf, but he missed him as he was his friend and brother.

Underbog is the 2nd 5-man instance within the Coilfang Reservoir found on the east side of the naga invested complex. The Underbog is home to the last vestiges of natural life left within Coilfang Reservoir that has not been completely stamped out by the Naga incursion. The only Naga presence in this section defends the structure they built to house their hydra god, Ghaz'an. The rest of the Underbog is a natural habitat, home to the most powerful species of animal life in Zangarmarsh.

Under-King Anub'et'kan is the current leader of the scourge populating the ruins of Icemist Village. Players must kill him during the Strength of Icemist (quest) quest chain. It should be noted that an entrance into Azjol-Nerub is near Icemist Village which is probably the reason why most of the scourge in the ruins are Undead Nerubians.

Unnatural Malice is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from the following bosses: *Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae).
Ursula Deline is a human warlock trainer located in the cellar of the Slaughtered Lamb pub in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.

Urtrun Clanbringer is an orc guild master located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in the Horde Embassy. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Warchief's Herald.
Urda is an orc flight master located at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

Urel Stoneheart was the first earthen king. He received Val'anyr, Hammer of Ancient Kings from the titans themselves. With it he was to create and give life to the rest of his brethren. Urel Stoneheart's hammer Val'anyr was shattered during the first war between the earthen and the iron dwarves and its remnants were believed lost in the conflict. But the hammer's fragments were later found in Ulduar, with which the hammer was reforged by throwing the fragments into liquefied saronite inside Yogg-Saron, and was retrieved after the Old God's defeat.
Urtol Skyshear is an orc flight master located at the Vault of the Earth in Tanaan Jungle.

Uthel'nay is a jungle troll mage trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. After the Cataclysm, he spoke with Godan about the mage adventurer. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. He joined the Tirisgarde and is located in the Hall of the Guardian. Following the formation of the Armies of Legionfall, he sells Magical Saucer.
Vahgruk is an orc flight master located at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

Utgarde Pinnacle is the second of Utgarde Keep's two 5-man wings. It used to be a level 80 instance, and you had to be at least level 75 to enter it. The instance has its own meeting stone at the top level of the keep. Utgarde Pinnacle is located at the top of the keep and is where the more powerful and supreme of the Vykrul live.
Valarian is a night elf located at T&W Trading Post in the Canals in Stormwind City.

Valenia Silvermoon is an elven wizard. She is one of the few scholars on Azeroth that have, like Khadgar, dedicated their lives to considering the riddle of many planes of existence and the possibility of travel between them. Just months before Dalaran fell to the Scourge, she traveled there to put forth the theory that just as Outland was once a place unknown to the people of Azeroth, so are there other worlds waiting to be discovered. She even claimed to have theories about how these places might be reached based on her studies of the Second War. Unfortunately, though stories of her presentation to the mage's council survived with those who escaped the capture of Dalaran by the undead, Sil
Valorous Earthshatter Regalia is the 25-man version of the tier 7 restoration shaman set.
Valorous Earthshatter Garb is the 25-man version of the tier 7 elemental shaman set.
Valorous Earthshatter Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 enhancement shaman set.

Valerie Langrom is a human found inside the Langrom's Leather & Links shop in Dalaran. She sells the Tier 7 and Tier 8 armor pieces for Druids and Rogues and other leather armor. During the purge of Dalaran, she was sleeping under the counter. When Dalaran relocated above Deadwind Pass and the Burning Legion attacked the city, she fought against the demons in the street.
Valentina Karmen is a human located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun.

Varedis Felsoul was a former Illidari demon hunter who used to run the training grounds for demon hunter initiates, teaching them about demons and overseeing training duels as master tutor inside the Ruins of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley. After his death, Varedis was revived by Kil'jaeden and convinced to join the Burning Legion.
Varanis Bitterstar is a blood elf mage and master of the arcane. He is surrounded by Verdant Spheres, indicating he is a blood mage.
Vargastrasz is a member of the red dragonflight located at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight.

Varlam is a high ranking member of the Wolfcult and lieutenant to Arugal. He can be found on Bloodmoon Isle in Grizzly Hills. While the adventurers attacked the tower and managed to kill Arugal, his death was ordered by Sasha who accompanied them.

Vann was a human rider who Danath Trollbane chose to take with him along with half of the military in Stormwind City to the Dark Portal. He first appeared when he interrupted and disapproved when Danath said the Horde was not defeated. When arriving at the Dark Portal he urged Danath to flee to warn Nethergarde Keep for every Alliance on the battlefield knew that they could not win. He was killed on the battlefield by a :club-wielding orc as he cheered for the Sons of Lothar for one last time.

Vazruden is an armored fel orc found flying around the tower of the Hellfire Ramparts wing of the Hellfire Citadel instance in Hellfire Peninsula on his nether drake named Nazan. He had a riding crop, but Nazan took it since he refused to let Vazruden hit him with it.
Veiled Shadows is a Tier 1 talent in the priest Shadow talent tree that reduces the cooldown of the priest's Fade and Shadowfiend abilities.

Vaultkeeper Razhid is an ethereal void banker found in the Canals of the human capital of Stormwind City. He, along with his associates Warpweaver Hashom, Voidbinder Sturzah, and Thaumaturge Rafir, manages the shop The Three Winds which specialises in typical ethereal services such as transmogrification, Razhid being responsible for void storage.
Vaultkeeper Pieta is a human banker in the Shrine of Seven Stars.

Verand was a junior officer of Alterac that learned about Aiden Perenolde's decision of abandoning the Alliance of Lordaeron and letting the Horde march to Lordaeron through Alterac's mountains. He wondered if the Horde could be trusted. It is unknown what happened to him after the Second War.
Venrik is a human located in Dead Man's Tale in Tiragarde Sound. He and Flynn Fairwind used to get drunk and then take a couple of riding parrots out for fun.
Vhulgra is an orc flight master located at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
Veronica Faraday is a human located at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. She appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight, already dead.
Vetrigosa was a blue dragon who was slain by the black dragonflight. Her name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Vigil Hill Medic is a human located in Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound. She is healing the wounded Flynn Fairwind.
Victor Bradwell is a human located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
Vindicaar Matrix Core is the Vindicaar core that allows the champion to choose from four powers.
Vivianna is a night elf trade supplies vendor located at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. She is one of the many vendors located around the statue of a warrior.
Vlagga Freyfeather is an orc flight master located at the Stair of Destiny in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Vivian was a human female and the mother of Thassarian and Leryssa. She and her children lived alone on a farm because her husband, Killoren, had died and was said to be a hero. When Thassarian was ordered to join Prince Arthas' army, Vivian was saddened but after all she gave him an amulet which belonged to his father as a blessing. Arthas Menethil forced Thassarian to kill her after becoming a death knight during the fall of Capital City in the Third War. He obeyed and tossed the amulet he got from her. Right after this, the amulet was found by William Allerton, and it presumably ended in the hands of Leryssa.
Viviana Swailes is a human flight master located in Falconhurst in Drustvar.
Vok Blacktongue is an orc located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak. He was a high ritualist of Shadowmoon, and a master runecarver.
Voidtender Malketh is a human located at the Pools of Power in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Upon reaching 50% health, he will transform into a n'raqi.
Vynan Sunblade is a blood elf paladin featured in Fantasy Flight Games' World of Warcraft: The Board Game.
Wanathan is an orc inside The Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within the mage city of Dalaran.
Wandering Behemoth is a dragon turtle located in Island Expeditions.
Warcaller Beersnout is a Wildhammer dwarf found at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.

Warden Silva is a human located in The Hole in the Warden's Chambers on the island of Tol Barad. He is only accessible when The Hole dailies are available. He carries the Warden's Keys. He and his former guards are now in cahoots with rogue mages, lording over a group of imprisoned workers.
Wargra is an orc flight master located at Windreaver's Rise in .
Warlord Morkh is a fel orc found in inside the barracks of Zeth'Gor in the Hellfire Peninsula. After killing him, the Eye of the Citadel briefly appears.
Warmage Hollister is a human located at the Transitus Shield in the Borean Tundra. She is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Watkins is a human located at the Transitus Shield in the Borean Tundra. She is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Calandra is a human located at the Transitus Shield in the Borean Tundra. She is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Anzim is a human at the Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra, where he handles the red drakes allied to the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Austin is a human at the Amber Ledge of the Borean Tundra. He is mounted on a red drake and is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Moran is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra. He is mounted on a red drake and is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Archus is a human located at the Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra. He is mounted on a red drake and is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.
Warmage Preston is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra. He is mounted on a red drake and is one of the Kirin Tor warmages deployed to fight against the Blue dragonflight.

Warlord Rok'nah is an elite Mag'har orc who is in charge of the Horde forces sent to loot the spoils of war from the ruins of the post destroyed Theramore. He is the final boss for the scenario Theramore's Fall (Alliance) where Jaina Proudmoore and Alliance adventurers slay him at the climactic end.
Warren Wainwright is a human banker located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Warren Fulton is a human located at the Shady Lady in Stormwind City.
Whippie Jennson is a human located by Dao Ironplow in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Wilhelm Strang is a human mail armor vendor located in Limited Immunity in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Wilder Thistlenettle is a dwarf located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City. He and his brother were members of a mining company until they were caught in a cave-in within the Deadmines. Though Wilder escaped, the rest of the company was killed, and they now roam the collapsed tunnel as restless undead. In Classic, he can be found in a nearly empty pub in the Dwarven District. It's the first building on the right when coming through the district's southeastern entrance.
William Henry is a human located at the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City, running with Lilian Mae.

Wildtwister Lewor is the former leader of the ruined grove at the Crumbled Ridge in Ardenweald. When the anima leached from the grove's surroundings and the local gorm began to feed on the land, he worried for his people. He sent messengers to call on the Wild Hunt for help, but no one could spare any troops. Unsure what else he could do, Lewor prayed, hoping the forest would provide a way through their ordeal. Lewor thought his prayers were answered when he stumbled upon a stone, foreign to Ardenweald and radiating a strange power. He was sure he could use it to pacify or even defeat the gorm. Though most of the gorm are now dead, the stone apparently corrupted Lewor, and he went on to corr
Wilder Seabraid is a dwarf located at T&W Trading Post in the Canals in Stormwind City. He is a co-owner of the trading post, along with Tawny Seabraid.
Wind Tamer Shoshok is an orc flight master located at the recently taken Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale.
Windhunter is an orc flight master located at Wolf's Stand in Frostfire Ridge.
Windflight Arrows is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.

Wing Commander Ichman is an elite human serving as lead wing commander of the Stormpike Guard in Alterac Valley. At the beginning of each match, he is held prisoner at the West Frostwolf Tower. Ichman and his Horde counterpart, Wing Commander Mulverick, have since quit their respective jobs in Alterac Valley and made their way to Outland, where they now serve the Dragonmaw clan at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. Ichman specifically cited the amount of whining done by the Frostwolf clan about how unfair the bridge into Dun Baldar was. While in Outland, Ichman is friendly to both Alliance and Horde players who have completed the quest Blood Oath of the Netherwing.

Wing Commander Mulverick is an elite orc serving as lead wing commander of the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley. At the beginning of each match, he is held prisoner in the Dun Baldar North Bunker. "Mulv" and his Alliance counterpart, Wing Commander Ichman, have since quit their respective jobs in Alterac Valley and made their way to Outland, where they now serve the Dragonmaw Clan at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. Mulverick, in particular, was disgusted at the Frostwolves for the sheer amount of pathetic whining during battle, and wished to finally be rid of the infernal complaining. While in Outland, Mulverick is friendly to both Alliance and Horde players who have completed
Windscreamer is an orc flight master located at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.

Woo Ping was a human located in Weller's Arsenal in the Trade District of Stormwind City. He was a weapon master, and taught the skill to wield the following: *Crossbow *Daggers *One-handed swords *Two-handed swords *Polearms *Staves
Wrathscale Point is a southern area of Azuremyst Isle that has a small night elf ruin overrun by Wrathscale naga planning to overtake the island. The place is filled with ancient relics.
Wu Shen is a human warrior trainer located in the Command Center in Old Town in Stormwind City.
Wynne Larson is a human robe vendor located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.

Wyrtle Spreelthonket is an goblin mercenary located in Blackrock Stronghold in the Burning Steppes. He works for the Blackrock orcs. It's unknown what happened to him after the Blackrock invasion of the Redridge Mountains failed.
Wulfigosa was a blue dragon who was slain by the black dragonflight. Her name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Xiggs Fuselighter is a dwarf located at the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward within Ironforge. Before the Cataclysm, Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter used to come to Azshara to the helipad on his flying machine as part of his quest chain. He owns a favor or two to Tymor.

Xander Jaxon is a human boy located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. Every hour, on the hour, he buys coffee from Travis Nichols and brings it to his mother, Auctioneer Jaxon, in the Trader's Hall.

Xeritas is the fel lord commander in charge of the Assault on Azsuna. After four invasion points of the Burning Legion have been pushed back he declares that adventurers should bow before the Burning Legion and that their efforts are meaningless. He later taunts adventurers by declaring that they are meddling with powers that they do not understand and that the end of Azeroth is near. Xeritas is ultimately slain on his Legion ship in order to liberate Azsuna from the Legion's Assault.
Xavier Carpenter is a human located in the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind City.
Xylinnia Starshine is a night elf artisan enchanting trainer located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Yarrog Baneshadow is an orc found in the Burning Blade Coven in the Valley of Trials. Yarrog is a member of the Burning Blade. He is responsible for summoning the Felstalkers and Vile Familiars and commands his spawns from the Coven. Yarrog wears a medallion that grants him much of his power.
Yngwie is a powerful pygmy witch doctor and leader of Oomlot Village located on the Lost Isles.
Yoori is a night elf fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. She died after the portal was destroyed.
Yugrek is an orc flight master located just northwest from the gates of Everlook in Winterspring.
Yul Wildpaw is a rare pandaren monk, found meditating over the western cliffs on the island of Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes. Yul is a pandarian champion.
Yu Fei is a pandaren mage who was opening portals for everyone who needed them during the trial of Garrosh Hellscream. She was also magically unlocking and locking Garrosh's cell when necessary.
Yvia Wavebound is a human located in the Sanctum of the Sages in Boralus. She teaches the Portal and Teleport spells to level 111 mages of the Alliance.

Zahlia is a human located in the Shattrath Infirmary in Shattrath's Lower City alongside her son, Seth. She was rendered blind after suffering a severe injury to the head. Sha'nir asks adventurers to help make a cure for her. Seth mentions that he is from Lakeshire, which would mean that Zahlia is also from there.

Zanazal is a former ruler of the Zandalari Empire and member of the Council of Tribes. His remains are buried within the Halls of Ash in Kings' Rest, in Atal'Dazar. During the fight, he briefly regains a physical form before turning into ash again.

Zahra Sandstalker is a human located at the courtyard of the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. She can be found standing with Arik Scorpidsting and Captain Navid Sandstone. She was previously one of the Wastewanders who joined with Schnottz's crew, as she speaks about having previously flown one of his bombers during the Assault in Uldum.
Zankaja is an orc located between the Valley of Wisdom and the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with a Darkspear Headhunter.

Zathra is a sand troll mercenary who joined the Hidden as their tracker. She originally lived in Zul'Farrak, where many of her ancestors are buried. After her mother died, she left the city, which was a long time ago. When she was small, she used to think that the pyramid stretched to the clouds. She assisted the Hidden in an attack on the Wavestrider and killed several deckhands, including Thom Frakes. She joined the group on a trek in Feralas, sending her scorpid pet Skitter to track Aramar Thorne and Makasa Flintwill and later the Gordunni ogres who captured them. The Hidden entered Dire Maul and watched Malus as he defeated King Gordok and became the new leader of the ogres. When Aram an

Zaurac is a storm dragon summoned by Typhinius to attack Li Li Stormstout and the monk adventurer in Skywall. After being defeated, the dragon lands on the platform and is used by the adventurer to fly them to the next platform with Typhinius, upon which the dragon flies away.

Zelena Moonbreak is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Zzeraku was a nether dragon taken captive by Sintharia and used in her experiments at Grim Batol to create a new flight of dragons.

Zur'ak Firefist is a troll shaman of the Earthen Ring and a member of its Elder Council. He believed that the elements had abandoned the Earthen Ring. Zur'ak alongside Kettara Bloodthirst, Krelna, Lenka, were waiting for a meeting with Drek'Thar. After the meeting, he alongside his master and colleagues noticed a fire in Camp Narache. He battled against the fire and centaur but the shaman were forced to retreat to Bloodhoof Village. There the shaman, especially Zur'ak, talked about how elements abandoned them. Ada Gelhardt is a human paladin found on an island off the Darkened Bank in . She wants to leave the Light and join the Cult of the Damned. Paladins who have previously found the Charred Note (Season of Discovery) can challenge her in order to get the Rune of Divine Light.

Adarus Duskblaze is a blood elf demon hunter of the Illidari trained by Illidan Stormrage. He wants to tame the power of Void. He is located in Shan'dorah in K'aresh and can be seen training on a Training Dummy.

Aeonas is a human paladin found in the chamber at the back of the Scarlet Monastery Cathedral after defeating Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane. Upon returning to Stormwind City, he becomes Aeonas the Vindicated.
Aedh Firebeard is a Wildhammer dwarf located at the Midsummer camp in the Canals in Stormwind City.
Aeonelle Blackstar is a void elf demon hunter located in the Voidstorm.
Alania Hollowbark is a night elf located in the Trade District in Stormwind City.
Alesil Dawnblood is a blood elf located at Dawnstar Spire in Eversong Woods.

Alphonse Constant is a human located outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. After finding one of his Darkmoon Fortune Cards scattered around the celebration area, he starts Deck Dismay, one of the quests required for Assistant to the Assistant Guest Relations Manager as part of Guest Relations.
Almia Moonwhisper is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.
Alton Parsons is a human located in the Blue Recluse and Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City and in Harandar.
An'drak is an orc located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
Ar'syn is a nerubian sage located in the Skeins in the City of Threads.

Aravan Salonar was a young high elf noble and a member of the House of Salonar. Years before the Great Wars, Aravan and his brother Rendris attended a party at Saltheril's Haven. They were joking about Lirath Windrunner and his lean build, inability to fight, and how he would use the flute in a duel. Sylvanas Windrunner overhead the jokes and intended to give them drinks with woundwood, but Lord Saltheril and Elisara Sunstriker drank them instead. During the burning of Quel'Thalas, Windrunner Village came under attack from the Old Horde and their Amani troll allies. They slaughtered most of the elves there, including Aravan. After the Horde retreated, Sylvanas arrived and discovered the dead
Archmage Galdrin is a human located in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City.

Armorer Kalinovan was a blood elf located at the elven basecamp in the Twilight Highlands during the Twilight Ascension event. He sold equipment in exchange for . From 3 March to 17 March 2026 (between the end of the event and the start of Midnight Season 1), Armorer Kalinovan could also be found next to the Twilight Highlands portal in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar, where he sold his items for Resonance Crystals. Standing across from him was Materialist Ophinell, who sold cosmetic rewards.

Ashley Hammond is a human child located at the Hammond Farmstead in Gilneas and later in Gilneas City. She is the daughter of Melinda Hammond and is sister to her two siblings Cynthia and James. When the Forsaken attack, she was caught off guard. She would be rescued by a recently turned worgen under the care of Krennan Aranas. Along with the rest of her family, she is later seen on a night elf ship at Keel Harbor, ready to flee to Darnassus. Years later, after the reclamation of Gilneas, she reappeared as a grown young woman fending off spiders with her sister, Cynthia, in Stormglen Village. Avian Specialization is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It also grants the Fetch (eagle) ability. It is an exclusive choice node with Unbreakable Bond.

Aymestrasz is a red drake and one of Lailastrasza's companions, whom she considers to be her second-in-command. The duo and their friends fought against the djaradin, and he helped her to lead a devastating assault against Scalecracker Keep.
Azarian was a member of the black dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause, an act for which Azarian was brought to the dungeons of the Obsidian Citadel for questioning.
Baj'ura is a jungle troll priest located in the War Quarter in the Undercity. She aids a Forsaken priest adventurer make contact with the loa.

Baelgrim was the former Stormward of Khaz Algar, the leader of the Stormriders in charge of defending the earthen on the Isle of Dorn. He was the very embodiment of the Stormriders and the foremost expert on stormrooks. His stormrook companion is named Zarein. After he sacrificed himself to destroy Queensguard Zirix and his nerubian forces, he was succeeded in the position by Lufsela.
Bayki is a duck toy found behind the flight master dragon in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Baxtan is a great goblin mage. He is the author of Baxtan: On Destructive Magics.

Berian was a member of the black dragonflight and one of the swiftest fliers available to them. He was sent to Umbrenion with a fulgurite produced by Raszageth during her attack upon a mortal village.

Bojsanz was the leader of the Heart's Guard during the War of the Scaleborn and a favored champion of Alexstrasza. Bojsanz slew Vyranoth's lieutenant Vitelenoth at Icewing Rift with the help of Stoltria, and alongside Levarian engaged in combat with Fyrakk during the Battle of Flamesfall. Bojsanz was put in charge of the aerial defenses of Valdrakken during the Primalist push on the city. During the Battle of Harrowsdeep, Bojsanz fought at Alexstrasza's side.
Boundless Moonlight is an Elune's Chosen hero talent for druids.
Brother Romulus is a human in Stormwind Cathedral in Stormwind City.
Brundia Braidhammer is a dwarf who sells toys and pets during Children's Week in Stormwind City. Leial Knitterton is her Horde counterpart in Orgrimmar.
Caeris Fairdawn is a blood elf located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods. He is the renown quartermaster for the Silvermoon Court major faction.
Cataloger Moonsage is a night elf located at the Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet.

Cristalstrasz was the leader of the red dragonflight's Ruby Flamebringers during the War of the Scaleborn, and was personally responsible for the deaths of countless Primalists. Fyrakk regarded him as a brute when he saw Cristalstrasz at the Battle of Flamesfall. Cristalstrasz later accompanied Alexstrasza to the Icebound Eye to oversee her duel with Vyranoth. He was present in the Battle of Harrowsdeep.
Dark Empowerment is a Dark Ranger hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Grave Reaper.
Darkening Horizon is a Voidweaver hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Void Empowerment.

Demonic Intensity is a Scarred hero talent for demon hunters. It upgrades the following abilities in Demon Form: *Eye Beam becomes Abyssal Gaze *Immolation Aura becomes Consuming Fire *The Hunt (Devourer) becomes Predator's Wake *Voidblade becomes Pierce the Veil *Hungering Slash becomes Reaper's Toll
Diverted Power is a Scalecommander hero talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Extended Battle.
Doelia Moonwater is a night elf located at the Gala of Gifts by the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest during Love is in the Air.
Doctor Bones is a skeletal warrior located in the Trade District in Stormwind City, in Orgrimmar and in the Searing Basin. He provides a large number of skillbooks and consumables.

Doug Roberts is a human explorer. He seems to have ties to the Mind-Seekers, but his existence is otherwise shrouded in mystery. Two records are displayed at the Seat of Knowledge during the Mind-Seeker secret. One is hidden behind a pillar in the western corner. The other is located out of bounds above the room, with the base of the projector being visible through the ceiling. He can be seen using Far Sight, a Scrying Roguestone or similar abilities.

Durdek Karrin was a dwarf who was found at the Misty Pine Refuge in Dun Morogh during the original beta. He taught the following hunter pet abilities: *Enraging Bite *Growl of Fortitude *Roar of Fortitude

Ebon Destroyer is a black dragon located in the Outer Seal in the Vault of the Incarnates. It can be ridden to damage the mobs on the way to Eranog before Raszageth appears and it is forced to retreat.

Egnion was the leader of the black dragonflight's Shadowscales. He spent most of his time afield spying on the Primalist forces. He delivered a report to the Seat of the Aspects that the Dragon-Queen's longtime friend Vyranoth had been spotted in the company of Raszageth the Storm-Eater, an act which Neltharion apologized for as the Shadowscales should have delivered it to her in private. He also delivered reports to his Aspect about the numbers of the Primalist forces and failures to solidly prove that Iridikron was responsible for increased seismic activity in the Broodlands. Elaine Compton is a human vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City in or Three Corners in in .

Elder Shadeweaver is a nerubian sage located in the Transformatory in the City of Threads. At first, they are a regular nerubian named Honored Citizen. Upon being approached, Izo, the Grand Splicer transforms them into a sage.
Ellegos was a member of the blue dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause. Ellegos was among those taken to the dungeons of the Obsidian Citadel for questioning.

Ellegosa was a member of the blue dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause. Ellegosa intended to open a passageway between the Chittering Caverns and Algeth'ar Academy for the Primalists to launch an assault on Malygos' forces through.
Eradicate is a Devourer demon hunter talent. It grants the Eradicate ability when active.
Extended Battle is a Scalecommander hero talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Diverted Power.

Ezrigeth (or Erzigeth) is an earth proto-dragon who briefly attacks Alexstrasza along with Raszageth and Jadzigeth at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. He then again accompanies Raszageth to disrupt Alexstrasza's ritual with the Mother Oathstone at Tyrhold in Thaldraszus but is dispatched by the adventurer.
Fel'orei Moonstrider is a night elf located at the Town Center in Founder's Point.
Festering Scythe is an Unholy death knight talent. It grants the Festering Scythe ability when active.

Fern Shadestar is a void elf located in Windrunner Village in Eversong Woods. She is friends with Numia Golden, who was supposed to arrive and help her assess flowers. When she did not appear, Fern sent an adventurer to check on her.
Future Chromie is a bronze dragon found in Thaldraszus. She is Morchie, posing as the main universe Chromie.

Galenori is a night elf who came to the Central Encampment to warn the Aspects when the Eye of Ysera was attacked by Galok Wingslicer. She was among the fighters gathered by Somnikus to defend the Eye and went on to fight the enemies at the flight master plateau.

Garion Wendell is a human librarian located in the Wizard's Sanctum of the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. He allows mages to turn in various books found throughout the world. His Horde counterpart is Owen Thadd.
Gilbert Gray is a human located on a pier in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
Jornah is an orc vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity.
Glacial Chill is a Frost mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Glacial Shatter.
Glacial Shatter is a Frost mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Glacial Chill.
Gleaming Rays is a Herald of the Sun paladin hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Morning Star (paladin hero talent).

Grand Splicer Xini'tith is a nerubian sage depicted by a statue in the Skeins in the City of Threads, southeast of the Royal Preservatorium. The statue's plaque can only be understood while under the effects of Potion of Polymorphic Translation: Nerubian.
Grave Reaper is a Dark Ranger hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Dark Empowerment.
Great Black Dragon Turtle is a dragon turtle located at the pandaren camp in Stormwind City.
Great Red Dragon Turtle is a dragon turtle located at the pandaren camp in Stormwind City.
Greymane Seneschal is a human located in Greymane Manor in Gilneas and Cathedral Square in Gilneas City.
Grunenstur Balindom was a dwarf who was found just outside Thelsamar in Loch Modan during the original beta. He taught the following hunter pet abilities: *Consume Flesh *Pierce Ankle *Quick Snap
Hanaeria Mooncaller is a night elf found speaking with Toriesia Shimmesword in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.

Harrostrasza is a red dragon vendor located in the Parting Glass in Valdrakken. She trades the single Awakened Mark of Mastery players can earn during Dragonflight Season 4 for an Awakened Normal (ilvl 502 Champion 4/8) or Heroic (ilvl 512 Hero 3/6) tier piece.
Healing Elixir is a level 75 monk talent. It is an exclusive choice with Dampen Harm and Diffuse Magic.
Holy Armaments is a Lightsmith paladin hero talent. It grants the abilities Holy Bulwark and Sacred Weapon.
Hooded Mageblade is a human who is located at the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine for Things Left Undone and Settled Dust during the final chapter of the Undermine(d) campaign.
Howard Freeman is a human located in the Old Town in Stormwind City.
Hungering Slash is a Devourer demon hunter talent. When activated it grants the Hungering Slash ability.
Idrieth Mossgrove is a night elf located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

Staccato is a blood elf temporal investigator for the Timewalkers. Though eager to help, he typically makes a mess of things and thus is given simple, menial tasks by his comrades to keep him out of trouble. Amongst his tasks have been the cleanup after the Corrupted Blood incident, polishing the crystalized Magni Bronzebeard in Old Ironforge, and taking over for Rhonin in his "Citizens of Dalaran" speech so Rhonin could take a bathroom break. He's had a number of mishaps in the past such as piercing the Veil between Azeroth and the Shadowlands by dropping the Helm of Domination after polishing it for the Lich King, and breaking one of the Bronze dragonflight's hourglasses, creating an alter
Jadefire Stomp is a Windwalker monk talent. Mistweaver monks can also use this ability via Emperor's Elixir.
Jade Empowerment is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Morning Breeze.
Jaelof Ironhart is a dwarf located in the Emperor's Step in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Ja'free is a nerubian sage located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.
